name: prompt-670
image_purpose: mirror selfie, plush-hat, and toy-store reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a colorful toy store with generic animal-themed merchandise.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark hair, wearing a secure opaque light-colored knee-length dress, pearl necklace, generic orange fox-ear plush hat, and holding a yellow smartphone while winking playfully.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body or three-quarter oval-mirror selfie, shelves of generic animal plush toys, festive lights, bright retail interior, and a large friendly gray rabbit mascot plush nearby. Do not use named franchises, recognizable copyrighted characters, or branded signage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright colorful toy-store lighting with warm festive accents and playful retail mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, accurate mirror geometry, detailed plush texture, natural skin and fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman in a secure opaque light-colored knee-length dress and pearl necklace takes a playful oval-mirror selfie in a colorful toy store, wearing a generic orange fox-ear plush hat and holding a yellow phone. Include generic animal plush shelves, festive lights, and a friendly gray rabbit mascot plush. No franchise names, logos, branded signage, or public figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, strapless mini dress, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, franchise character likeness, branded signage, distorted mirror, extra fingers, watermark, public figure likeness.
